name: Vodka
siboNotes: Pure vodka is distilled and contains no FODMAPs, making it suitable for SIBO diets. However, alcohol can affect gut motility and should be consumed in moderation.
preparationTips: Choose plain, unflavored vodka to avoid added sugars or flavorings
Mix with low-FODMAP mixers like fresh lime juice or club soda
Avoid flavored vodkas which may contain high-FODMAP ingredients
Consume with food to minimize digestive irritation
nutritionalHighlights: Zero carbohydrates and FODMAPs when plain
